description: What was appended between two versions, (from, to]: who contributed, when and how many records, and up to `limit` of the added records. limit=0 is public metadata; records need auth. Use it to catch up from a version you already read, without reading the whole version again (read_dataset) or downloading it (dataset_manifest); the latest version numbers are in dataset_info.

from.description: the changes after this version, which must be below to; left out, 0 (from the first version)

limit.description: added records to return, 0–500; 0 answers only who contributed what and when, with no key; left out, 100

slug.description: the dataset project's slug, as list_datasets gives it (e.g. agent-api-observatory): 3–60 lowercase letters, digits and dashes

to.description: the last version whose changes are included, from 1

name: dataset_diff
title: Dataset changes between versions
